name: codearts
label: CodeArts Agent (码道)
description: Huawei Cloud's CodeArts code agent CLI (码道), driven headlessly
tagline: Huawei Cloud's code agent in the terminal, authenticated with a Huawei Cloud access key. Installed by Huawei's own script.

env_config.name: CODEARTS_CLI_AK
env_config.description: Huawei Cloud access key ID (AK). The CLI accepts no other credential when it runs headless — create an access key as described at https://codearts.huaweicloud.com/portal/settings/cli-auth.

env_config.name: CODEARTS_CLI_SK
env_config.description: Secret access key (SK) paired with the access key ID above.

env_config.name: CODEARTS_MODEL
env_config.description: Model to run on, as provider/model. Leave empty to use the first model your access key can run; `codearts models` lists them.

check_ready.not_ready_message: Needs a Huawei Cloud access key — set CODEARTS_CLI_AK and CODEARTS_CLI_SK (press e). Create one at https://codearts.huaweicloud.com/portal/settings/cli-auth.
